WITH invoice_company AS (
  SELECT 
    il.InvoiceId,
    c.Company,
    COUNT(*) as line_count,
    AVG(il.UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price
  FROM InvoiceLine il
  JOIN Invoice i ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
  JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
  GROUP BY il.InvoiceId, c.Company
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(line_count) as total_lines FROM invoice_company
),
with_share AS (
  SELECT 
    ic.Company,
    ic.avg_unit_price,
    ic.line_count,
    CAST(ic.line_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_lines as share
  FROM invoice_company ic
  CROSS JOIN total t
),
by_company AS (
  SELECT 
    Company,
    AVG(avg_unit_price) as avg_price,
    SUM(line_count) as total_count,
    AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM with_share
  GROUP BY Company
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_price),
  AVG(total_count),
  AVG(avg_share)
FROM by_company
